title: Doofenshmirtz Evil Incorporated
blurb: "DOOFENSHMIRTZ EVIL INCORPORATED!" is the greatest jingle in children's television, sung by a full chorus for a man whose evil schemes have never once worked. Phineas and Ferb runs on Heinz Doofenshmirtz taking himself completely seriously while being completely ridiculous, and the theme announces that contradiction fresh every single episode. Nobody asked for a corporate anthem. He commissioned one anyway. Ideal for entering a room with unearned menace, or for naming any project that is definitely going to fail.
origin: Dr Doofenshmirtz's building jingle from Phineas and Ferb.
